lastCompletedStory.title: Add closeIssueOnMain on-main commit-tree close primitive

nextStoryContext: US-003 added closeIssueOnMain() to src/commands/issue-specify.ts (mirrors abandonIssueOnMain: checkMainUpToDate guard, readBacklogFromMain, commitTreeToMain with 'cam-specify-' prefix, pushMainBestEffort). The function sets stage:'shipped' on the target issue and returns { ok: false, reason: 'not-found' } when the id is absent. Types exported: CloseIssueOnMainOptions, CloseIssueOnMainResult, CloseIssueOnMainError, CloseIssueOnMainOutcome. Tests at test/issue-specify.test.ts (18 unit tests, all pass). The close primitive is now ready for US-004 to wire into the post-merge flow (closeIssueOnMain called from runPostMerge using the issueId threaded via .cam-merge-watch.json from US-002).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal git plumbing extension (mirrors abandonIssueOnMain); no external library exercised.
